title: Eleven Degrees of Difference
subtitle: 对比与反差 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 对比与反差（语言与思维·比较与对比）
meta: 主题语境：对比与反差（语言与思维·比较与对比）　|　核心词汇：contrast　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 contrast 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my teacher ① drew a contrast between two photographs of the same wall, and she said the drawing was the whole of the looking. The ② contrast, meaning the difference and not the wall, was eleven degrees and stayed that wide; contrast, she said, is the only thing in a pair that is judged by how much it shows at once.

Every ③ contrast in that essay had the same by phrase, and the ④ contrast at the end, meaning the one she kept for the last paragraph and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever underlined twice. Contrast, my mother said, is nine parts by phrase and one part somebody willing to look twice; my teacher said the looking twice is the part that fills the eleven degrees.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the contrast was the whole of the room, meaning the opposition and not the difference. The ⑥ contrast, meaning the opposition and not any of that, is the only thing in a room that everybody feels and nobody points at; contrast, he said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a difference and an opposition. She said the opposition is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ contrast had become a line in a margin note, and the note had become an argument about the by phrase. The ⑧ contrast of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in August, was one wall and thirty years of looking twice; contrast, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to look. He said the looking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ contrast I remember is the one at the end, which she drew in 1982 and is still described as the widest in the school. A ⑩ contrast, my mother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being looked at twice; every contrast, she said, is an opposition that has agreed to look like a difference. She said the opposition was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 反差（指那种差别本身，与那堵墙相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw a contrast between 在……之间作对比
D. n. 对比（指那篇文章里每一处）
E. n. 对比（指末尾那一处）
F. n. 对照；对立（抽象：那种相互对立）
G. n. 对比（指页边批注里提到的那一处）
H. n. 反差；差异（抽象总称）

items.q: drew a contrast between two photographs of the same wall
The contrast, meaning the difference and not the wall
the contrast was the whole of the room
the contrast had become a line in a margin note
The contrast of the whole thing
A contrast, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: draw a contrast between 意为“在……之间作对比”，1968 年老师在同一堵墙的两张照片之间作了对比。
contrast 意为“反差”，指那种差别本身而不是那堵墙，相差十一个等级。
contrast 指那篇文章里每一处对比，每一处都用了同样的 by 短语。
contrast 指末尾那一处（她留给最后一段的那一处），是唯一有人画过两次线的。
contrast 意为“对照、对立”，父亲说那种对立就是那个房间的全部，指的是相互对立而不是那种差别。
contrast 为抽象用法，指那种相互对立而不是那种差别，是房间里人人都感觉到、却无人指出的东西。
contrast 意为“对比”，指页边批注里提到的那一处，到 1976 年这处对比成了批注里的一行。
contrast 意为“反差、差异”，老师八月写道，整件事的反差是一堵墙三十年的看两遍。
contrast 意为“对比、对照”，我记得的是末尾那一处，她 1982 年作的，至今仍被说成全校反差最大的。
contrast 为抽象总称，母亲说一处对比是唯一会因为被看两遍而变好的东西。
